en: Sepia-toned devotional postcard depicting a statue of the Virgin Mary as Our Lady of Sorrows (B.V. Addolorata), with seven swords piercing her heart and radiant rays behind her head. She stands in elaborate robes, flanked by two kneeling putti or cherubs on either side. Below the image is an Italian caption indicating that this statue is venerated in the Cathedral of Trento.
